latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Instantly turn long YouTube videos into AI-generated highlight reels.

- Upload YouTube video footage and describe desired clips — no timeline editing or export settings needed.
- Handles automatic authentication with NEMO backend for free, rapid processing.
- Supports exports in multiple formats (mp4, mov, avi, webm, and more) up to 1080p.
- Includes workflows for exports, credit checks, timeline previews, and iterative editing.
- Automatic error handling covers tokens, sessions, credits, file size/format, and API usage limits.
- Optimized for fast highlight extraction: typical export is ready to download within 1-2 minutes.
